Step: f(x) $$=$$ $$-x$$

Hint 1: Consider the effect of the function f(x) $$=$$ $$-x$$ on the x-values. How does this transformation affect the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ in the scatterplot?

Hint 2: Think about whether the transformation f(x) $$=$$ $$-x$$ can help create a linear relationship between the transformed x-values and the y-values in the scatterplot.
